method_notes: Havering community infant and primary admission criteria 2027/28 (pp13-17, 'Distance of the home address from the school'): distance is measured in a straight line, not by walking or bus route, between a predetermined point for the school and the address point of the child's home; address points are at the centre of the home or the centre of a block of flats. Priorities: EHCP, looked-after/previously looked-after, exceptional medical/social, sibling (incl. partner infant/junior schools), staff children, then distance; distance also breaks ties within criteria 1-4; equal distances (same block of flats) decided by random draw by an officer not involved in admissions. The council's statistics tables label the furthest distance as 'Straight line distance' in km rounded to 3 decimal places, at initial allocation (16 April). Academies, free schools, the foundation school (Mawney) and faith schools set their own arrangements; not individually checked. The Drapers' academies have priority-area places (2024 table column).

Figures are initial-allocation (offer day) only. Own-admission-authority schools' measuring points (academies, Drapers' priority areas, faith schools, Mawney foundation) were not checked; straight line assumed. The community 'predetermined point' for each school is not specified (gate vs building). Squirrels Heath was an infant school in 2024-25 and is a primary from 2026 entry. Park Primary Academy opened Sept 2025, so 2024 is not_published. PAN is the 2026 'places available' figure (Hacton 88). Junior schools excluded. Postcodes and types from GIAS; Catholic schools are VA per GIAS. Dame Tipping has only 15 places.
